scope: Mountaineer Power Plant’s above-ground skyline in the cleared Qualla view, with the two tall concrete chimneys, single hyperbolic cooling tower and mapped generating hall complex.

originalReview.notes: The exact published Qualla original explicitly names the plant in the photographer’s first public-domain record. Its location and view show the pale, shorter active stack with a light upper band and the taller buff original chimney.

quallaSearch.notes: The verified Nyttend original is the sole image used. Native outlines and public agency text records control volumes outside the picture’s view.
